metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: Ada Reverse
records.biography_en: In The Runaway Misprint Foundry, Ada Reverse takes the role of typesetter. “It reads correctly from inside the press.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: one square wooden type block with a clearly backward raised capital R.

records.name: Bert Comma
records.biography_en: In The Runaway Misprint Foundry, Bert Comma takes the role of proofreader. “A pause. A much bigger pause.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: one giant curved burgundy comma with a small wooden grip.

records.name: Pip Misprint
records.biography_en: In The Runaway Misprint Foundry, Pip Misprint takes the role of escaped typo. “If anybody asks, I'm in the second edition.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small folded cream proof sheet with one simple smudged letter, used as a little shield while face remains visible.

records.name: Tess Inkroller
records.biography_en: In The Runaway Misprint Foundry, Tess Inkroller takes the role of press operator. “One coat will do.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small hand brayer with a smooth dark roller and brass handle.

records.name: Ollie Bindery
records.biography_en: In The Runaway Misprint Foundry, Ollie Bindery takes the role of bookbinder. “The spine can still be saved.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: palm-sized half-bound book and one thick thread loop.

records.name: Gus Margin
records.biography_en: In The Runaway Misprint Foundry, Gus Margin takes the role of margin inspector. “This margin is getting ideas.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: short wooden square ruler and one large blank cream page with a plain red border line.
